extractor_notes: BBAI 10-K (FY2021) is notably LIGHT on named DoD Program Elements or PE numbers. The only specifically-named Pentagon program is the U.S. Army Global Force Information Management (GFIM) Phase 1 Prototype. Most government-revenue narrative is generic ('U.S. Army', 'U.S. Air Force', 'Joint Staff', 'DHS') with customer concentration disclosed only via anonymized Customer A/B/C/D. Subject metadata (Project Maven / DARPA narrative) is NOT present in this 10-K text; those program associations appear to be management-PR commentary not filed in this 10-K. Cohort framing therefore tests: (a) the one named program (GFIM) against the J-Book corpus, (b) materiality / forward-load of the rollup thesis built around acquired subs (NuWave, PCI, ProModel, Open Solutions) without disclosing PEs, and (c) usaspending cross-check on BigBear.ai Federal LLC + subs against ANY DoD obligation trail.

claims.subject: BigBear.ai
claims.object_value: U.S. Army GFIM Phase 1 Prototype (one of two awards)
claims.source_quote: awarded one of two Global Force Information Management Phase 1 Prototype contracts by the United States Army

claims.claim_text: BigBear.ai's growth thesis depends on rollup M&A: AE Industrial Partners formed acquisition vehicles in 2020, then acquired NuWave Solutions (Jun 2020), PCI Strategic Management (Oct 2020), and ProModel (Dec 2020), forming the BigBear.ai entity that combined federal-contracting subsidiaries into a single AI/ML decision-support platform.
claims.subject: BigBear.ai roll-up structure
claims.object_value: NuWave (Jun 2020) + PCI (Oct 2020) + ProModel (Dec 2020) under BBAI Ultimate Holdings
claims.source_quote: On June 19, 2020, BigBear.ai acquired 100% of the equity of NuWave Solutions, LLC ... On October 23, 2020 BBAI Ultimate Holdings acquired PCI Strategic Management, LLC ... [ProModel] financed via the Antares Capital Term Loan in December 2020

claims.object_value: 665 employees, >80% cleared, HQ Columbia MD + 11 sites
claims.source_quote: As of December 31, 2021, we had 665 employees, of which over 80% held security clearances. Approximately 36% of our workforce is comprised of software engineers ... BigBear.ai has headquarters in Columbia, MD, with additional office locations in Lexington, Massachusetts; Annapolis, Maryland; Ann Arbor Michigan; Chantilly, Virginia; San Diego, California; Madison, Alabama; Charlottesville, Virginia; Virginia Beach, Virginia; McLean, Virginia; and Reston, Virginia.
